items.title: Is Cisco Systems (CSCO) Fully Priced After Its 104% Run?
items.summary: Cisco Systems has delivered a powerful share price run over the past few years. The sharper question for investors now is whether that recent market enthusiasm lines up with the cash the business can generate. After a pullback in recent weeks and a steady stream of AI focused headlines, the issue is whether the current US$98.65 tag reflects Cisco Systems' underlying cash flow profile or stretches it. Over the past 3 years the stock has returned 103.8%. This puts a lot of weight on the idea...
